_note: Synthetic corpus for the demo. Every person, place, and tool name here is invented; no real user data is included.

facts.text: Prefers short answers: lead with the conclusion, then at most three supporting points.
Works Monday to Friday, 08:00-16:00 local time.
Primary model is atlas-3-mini served through a local gateway.
Fallback chain: atlas-3-mini, then cedar-2-flash, then local-qwen.
Main workstation is a laptop with 32 GB RAM and a 2 TB drive, dual boot.
Home server: 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04, reachable by SSH key at ~/.ssh/demo-key.
Backups: weekly archive to ~/archive/ with the last four kept.
Calendar writes go only to the 'Work' and 'Personal' calendars.
Email drafts use the display name 'Nadia's Assistant' and are never sent automatically.
Meeting notes become decision, owner, and deadline; anything else is dropped.
Dislikes em dashes and exclamation marks in written output.
Prefers tables over prose when comparing more than three options.
Tracks expenses in a spreadsheet with monthly tabs, not in an app.
Runs every Wednesday at 06:30, 8 km, on the riverside loop.
Allergic to shellfish; carries a rennase tablet in the bag.
Reads two newsletters daily: a systems-design one and a markets one.
Learning Rust; working through the book a chapter a week.
Prefers the dark theme everywhere, with a serif font for reading.
Phone is on silent after 21:00; only calls from two contacts ring through.
Coffee: flat white, two shots, no sugar, before 11:00 only.
Current project is a static site generator in Go, deployed to a single VPS.
Rejected using a managed vector database; wants everything local.
Keeps a reading list in a single markdown file, one line per book.
Password manager is the only place credentials are stored; never in notes.
Prefers voice notes over long typed messages when commuting.
Reviews spending on the first of each month; saves 20 percent of income.
